evidence_checked: Published full XML metadata and Sections 2.1-2.5/4; Crossref bibliographic metadata agrees with Yuan et al. 2019, Advanced Science6(18):1900961; raw filenames prefixed li2019 are only acquisition filenames, not author attribution.
Main Figures3,4,6 visually inspected; descriptions of Figure2 inspected in text. Nine-page SI text inspected; FigureS2 and TablesS1/S2 visually inspected.

GenBank16S and WGS source qualifiers, current NCBI species page. Published XML status is-retracted=no; bounded exact-DOI correction/retraction query surfaced the original and citing literature, not a specific correction notice. This is not exhaustive.
limitations: Natural-water assay includes40mg added nutrient and growing biomass; no matched no-cell uranium timecourse in Figure6b, unresolved nutrient/membrane blank and compartment mass balance. Figure6e no-cell comparator concerns fouling only.

Initial-culture normalization differs from final dry cells. TableS2 U9456.59mg/kg divided by seawater0.00310mg/kg gives approximately3.05million, not tabulated625746.40. No corrected value is substituted.

TableS2 water U cell uses micrograms/kg despite generalmg/kg header. Other element uptake cannot be assigned uniquely to seawater with nutrient feed. No structured observations because analysis dates and full quantitative contract are unavailable.
Paper strain isolation beach sand conflicts with WGS seawater qualifier; neither identifies assay seawater collection. Molecular assays are separate spiked-media/debris experiments.

Bulk proteinase/shielding treatment and genomic cluster predictions do not establish a specific protein, antimicrobial molecule or in situ mechanism. No industrial deployment, regeneration or isolated U product demonstrated.
